name: higgsfield-media
description: Generates an image with the connected Higgsfield MCP server and lands it in this site's Media library. Encodes the four things generic MCP knowledge gets wrong about this connection: generate_image is asynchronous and returns a job id rather than an image, job_status sync:true can never complete over Tovu's federated transport, model choice is an account paywall (z_image works where gpt_image_2 and recraft_v4_1 return 'Requires basic plan or higher'), and the CDN URL only reaches the library through media_import_from_url.
author: Tovu
